idle.process: Unrevoke 界面进程（不含引擎子进程）
idle.note: 界面进程 180 秒采样；cpu_pct_with_checks = 界面 + 每 60 秒一次 doctor 子进程（0.25 s CPU/次）

background.job: 窗口打开时每 60 秒一次状态检查（wechattweak doctor）
background.note: per_run_s 与 cpu_s_per_run 为 5 次 /usr/bin/time 中位（含 codesign 等子进程），见 perf/raw/doctor-1.0.8-time.txt；关窗后停止，按全天开着窗口折算

data: 微信 build 269602（App Store 版），窗口打开、无操作

speed_gui.label: 后台打开（open -g -j）到首个状态检查子进程退出、界面拿到状态
speed_gui.label_en: Background open (open -g -j) until the first status-check subprocess exits and the UI has the status

why: 原生 SwiftUI 界面，无 Python 运行时；读写微信交给包内的 Swift 命令行引擎，窗口打开时每 60 秒起一次状态检查子进程、做完即退出，关窗即停；无常驻后台服务。
why_en: Native SwiftUI with no Python runtime. Reading and patching WeChat is handed to the bundled Swift command-line engine; while the window is open a status-check subprocess runs every 60 seconds and exits when done, stopping when the window closes. No resident background service.
data_en: WeChat build 269602 (App Store edition), window open, no interaction
